@@ -240,6 +240,11 @@ arithmetic:
   - sql: UUID_V7()
     table: uuidV7()
     description: Returns a time-ordered RFC 9562 version 7 UUID value, generated from the current timestamp and a random component. Compared to UUID(), this function returns a value of the UUID data type.
+  - sql: BIT_COUNT(expr)
+    table: expr.bitCount()
+    description: |
+      Returns an INT containing the number of set bits in the 64-bit two's-complement representation of an integer. Accepts TINYINT, SMALLINT, INT, BIGINT, or BOOLEAN. Negative integers are sign-extended to 64 bits before counting, regardless of their input type. TRUE returns 1 and FALSE returns 0. Returns NULL if expr is NULL.
+      E.g., BIT_COUNT(3) returns 2, BIT_COUNT(-1) returns 64, and BIT_COUNT(CAST(-128 AS TINYINT)) returns 57.
   - sql: BIN(INT)
     table: INT.bin()
     description: Returns a string representation of INTEGER in binary format. Returns NULL if INTEGER is NULL. E.g., 4.bin() returns "100" and 12.bin() returns "1100".

         """
         return _unary_op("end")(self)
 
+    @property
+    def bit_count(self) -> 'Expression[int]':
+        """
+        Returns the number of set bits in the 64-bit two's-complement representation of an integer.
+        Negative TINYINT, SMALLINT, and INT values are sign-extended to 64 bits before counting.
+        Boolean true and false return 1 and 0, respectively. Returns null if the argument is null.
+
+        For example, 3 returns 2 and -1 returns 64.
+        """
+        return _unary_op("bitCount")(self)

+package org.apache.flink.table.planner.functions;
+
+import org.apache.flink.table.api.DataTypes;
+import org.apache.flink.table.functions.BuiltInFunctionDefinitions;
+import org.apache.flink.table.types.DataType;
+
+import java.util.stream.Stream;
+
+import static org.apache.flink.table.api.Expressions.$;
+import static org.apache.flink.table.api.Expressions.lit;
+
+/** End-to-end tests for Spark-compatible BIT_COUNT in SQL and the Table API. */
+class BitCountFunctionITCase extends BuiltInFunctionTestBase {
+
+    @Override
+    Stream<TestSetSpec> getTestSetSpecs() {
+        return Stream.concat(
+                Stream.of(
+                        integerCases(
+                                DataTypes.TINYINT(),
+                                new Number[] {
+                                    (byte) 0, (byte) 3, (byte) -1, Byte.MIN_VALUE, Byte.MAX_VALUE
+                                },
+                                57,
+                                7),
+                        integerCases(
+                                DataTypes.SMALLINT(),
+                                new Number[] {
+                                    (short) 0,
+                                    (short) 3,
+                                    (short) -1,
+                                    Short.MIN_VALUE,
+                                    Short.MAX_VALUE
+                                },
+                                49,
+                                15),
+                        integerCases(
+                                DataTypes.INT(),
+                                new Number[] {0, 3, -1, Integer.MIN_VALUE, Integer.MAX_VALUE},
+                                33,
+                                31),
+                        integerCases(
+                                DataTypes.BIGINT(),
+                                new Number[] {0L, 3L, -1L, Long.MIN_VALUE, Long.MAX_VALUE},
+                                1,
+                                63),
+                        TestSetSpec.forFunction(BuiltInFunctionDefinitions.BIT_COUNT, "booleans")
+                                .onFieldsWithData(true, false, null)
+                                .andDataTypes(
+                                        DataTypes.BOOLEAN().notNull(),
+                                        DataTypes.BOOLEAN(),
+                                        DataTypes.BOOLEAN())
+                                .testResult(
+                                        resultSpec(
+                                                $("f0").bitCount(),
+                                                "BIT_COUNT(f0)",
+                                                1,
+                                                DataTypes.INT().notNull()),
+                                        resultSpec(
+                                                $("f1").bitCount(),
+                                                "BIT_COUNT(f1)",
+                                                0,
+                                                DataTypes.INT()),
+                                        resultSpec(
+                                                $("f2").bitCount(),
+                                                "BIT_COUNT(f2)",
+                                                null,
+                                                DataTypes.INT())),
+                        TestSetSpec.forFunction(
+                                        BuiltInFunctionDefinitions.BIT_COUNT, "constant folding")
+                                .onFieldsWithData(0)
+                                .withConstantFoldingEnabled()
+                                .testResult(
+                                        resultSpec(
+                                                lit(3).bitCount(),
+                                                "BIT_COUNT(3)",
+                                                2,
+                                                DataTypes.INT().notNull()),
+                                        resultSpec(
+                                                lit(-1).bitCount(),
+                                                "BIT_COUNT(-1)",
+                                                64,
+                                                DataTypes.INT().notNull()),
+                                        resultSpec(
+                                                lit(true).bitCount(),
+                                                "BIT_COUNT(TRUE)",
+                                                1,
+                                                DataTypes.INT().notNull()),
+                                        resultSpec(
+                                                lit(null, DataTypes.BIGINT()).bitCount(),
+                                                "BIT_COUNT(CAST(NULL AS BIGINT))",
+                                                null,
+                                                DataTypes.INT()))
+                                .testSqlResult("BIT_COUNT(NULL)", null, DataTypes.INT()),
+                        TestSetSpec.forFunction(
+                                        BuiltInFunctionDefinitions.BIT_COUNT, "argument count")
+                                .onFieldsWithData(0)
+                                .testSqlValidationError(
+                                        "BIT_COUNT()",
+                                        "No match found for function signature BIT_COUNT().")
+                                .testSqlValidationError(
+                                        "BIT_COUNT(1, 2)",
+                                        "No match found for function signature "
+                                                + "BIT_COUNT(<NUMERIC>, <NUMERIC>).")),
+                Stream.of(
+                                DataTypes.FLOAT(),
+                                DataTypes.DOUBLE(),
+                                DataTypes.DECIMAL(10, 2),
+                                DataTypes.STRING(),
+                                DataTypes.BYTES(),
+                                DataTypes.ARRAY(DataTypes.INT()))
+                        .map(
+                                type ->
+                                        TestSetSpec.forFunction(
+                                                        BuiltInFunctionDefinitions.BIT_COUNT,
+                                                        "reject " + type)
+                                                .onFieldsWithData(0)
+                                                .testTableApiValidationError(
+                                                        lit(null, type).bitCount(),
+                                                        "Invalid input arguments")
+                                                .testSqlValidationError(
+                                                        "BIT_COUNT(CAST(NULL AS " + type + "))",
+                                                        "Invalid input arguments")));
+    }
+
+    private static TestSetSpec integerCases(
+            DataType type, Number[] values, int minimumCount, int maximumCount) {
+        return TestSetSpec.forFunction(BuiltInFunctionDefinitions.BIT_COUNT, type.toString())
+                .onFieldsWithData(values[0], values[1], values[2], values[3], values[4], null)
+                .andDataTypes(type.notNull(), type, type, type, type, type)
+                .testResult(
+                        resultSpec(
+                                $("f0").bitCount(), "BIT_COUNT(f0)", 0, DataTypes.INT().notNull()),
+                        resultSpec($("f1").bitCount(), "BIT_COUNT(f1)", 2, DataTypes.INT()),
+                        resultSpec($("f2").bitCount(), "BIT_COUNT(f2)", 64, DataTypes.INT()),
+                        resultSpec(
+                                $("f3").bitCount(), "BIT_COUNT(f3)", minimumCount, DataTypes.INT()),
+                        resultSpec(
+                                $("f4").bitCount(), "BIT_COUNT(f4)", maximumCount, DataTypes.INT()),
+                        resultSpec($("f5").bitCount(), "BIT_COUNT(f5)", null, DataTypes.INT()));
+    }
+}
